properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): external_dependency replies with the whole dependency manifest (every declaration, as TOML), not a receipt. The reply grows about 150 bytes per declared dependency and names no node. The receipt layer recognises only node and edge records, so a write that returns anything else is never shaped, and nothing tests that every write's reply is one. The missing receipt also hides the lossy re-declare: components and features were cleared to "" and nothing in the reply said so
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triaging art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, tool friction 2 (and idea 19). Triage agent C, dev_reflow2 hub.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words: "`external_dependency` replies with a dependency-declaration rendering (about 11 KB) rather than a node receipt; only a `get_node` shows the pin was written."

② PRECEDENT:
- cap:a-write-replies-with-a-receipt (shipped in #630, 2026-09-29): one shape at the call_tool choke point for every write.
- fact:re-declaring-a-dependency-drops-the-resources-description-2026-09-23: the lossy re-declare, recurring through 0.76.0.
Neither names the reply shape of this tool.

⑤ MEASURED, reflow2-mcp 0.77.0 --call on a scratch store. Log: /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-C/measure.log.
- Declaring 1 to 6 dependencies gave replies of 486, 636, 786, 936, 1,086 and 1,236 bytes: +150 B per declaration, since each reply is the manifest of ALL of them. The reporter's ~11 KB is that at scale, or with an address baseline added.
- The reply is {"value": "<TOML>"}, with no node_id and no created-or-revised signal.
- A re-declare of dep:lib1 that omitted components and features cleared both to "" on the stored Resource (get_node). The reply carried no revision, no `replaced` and no removal note. It showed the shortened manifest entry only if the reader compared it with the earlier one.

③④ CODE, origin/main:
- built.rs external_dependency ends `ok_json(manifest)`, or `{value: manifest, address_baseline}` for an address declaration.
- receipt.rs is_record() keys on node_id+node_type+properties, or edge_type+from_id+to_id+properties.
- tests/a_write_replies_with_a_receipt.rs checks that every write DECLARES `echo`, and bounds the reply size for 7 named writes (add_decision, replace_text, set_decision_status, add_component, add_requirement, record_finding, create_edge). It never asserts that every write's default reply carries a record.
- tools/replies_are_bounded.py covers READ tools only, at 30,000 characters.
So no gate could catch this.

⑥ THE CLASS: the receipt contract was enforced by STRUCTURE, "a new write tool joins by being served". That holds only for handlers that return a NodeDto or EdgeDto. A write that returns a report, a manifest or a rendering is served, declares `echo`, and is silently exempt. How many writes reply in a non-record shape was NOT ENUMERATED here; external_dependency is the measured one.

UNDER MCP: identical. The shaping is at call_tool, which both routes pass.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether set_artifact_checksums, acknowledge_gaps, link_artifact and other report-shaped writes have the same gap.
